dull_whetstone.name: War-Breath Charm
dull_whetstone.text: First attack each combat deals +3 damage.

pilgrims_nail.name: Saint's Buckler
pilgrims_nail.text: The first time each combat you gain Block, gain +3 Block.

cracked_charm.name: Split-Second Charm
cracked_charm.text: First card played each combat costs 0.

rusted_fang.name: Bloodglass Thorn
rusted_fang.text: Whenever you apply Bleed, deal 1 bonus damage to that enemy.

bone_prayer_beads.name: Ashen Spur
bone_prayer_beads.text: Gain +1 energy on the first turn of each combat.

vein_drinker.name: Charred Wick
vein_drinker.text: Attacks deal +2 damage to enemies with Burn.

lantern_heart.name: Mercy Thread
lantern_heart.text: First lethal damage each run is prevented if you have Ward. Consume all Ward and survive at 1 HP.

hollow_crown.name: Debt Bell
hollow_crown.text: At the start of combat, add a temporary Dissonance to your hand, then draw 1.

infant_bell.name: Cracked Hymnal
infant_bell.text: Curse cards cost 0 the first time each combat.

mercy_root.name: Stone-Vow Rosary
mercy_root.text: If you end your turn with Block, retain 3 Block next turn.

red_thread_spool.name: Red Thread Spool
red_thread_spool.text: Bleed ticks 1 additional time on elite and boss enemies.

butchers_prayer.name: Butcher's Prayer
butchers_prayer.text: At the start of combat, apply 2 Bleed to all enemies.

hollow_ink.name: Hollow Ink
hollow_ink.text: Whenever a curse is added to your deck during combat, gain 1 Strength.

broken_metronome.name: Broken Metronome
broken_metronome.text: Every 4th card played each turn deals 4 bonus damage.

ember_nail.name: Ember Nail
ember_nail.text: Whenever you apply Burn, apply +1 additional Burn.

furnace_saint.name: Furnace Saint
furnace_saint.text: At end of your turn, deal damage equal to enemy Burn, then reduce Burn by 1.

pale_seal.name: Pale Seal
pale_seal.text: When Ward prevents a debuff, gain 4 Block.

red_muscle_idol.name: Red Muscle Idol
red_muscle_idol.text: Whenever you gain Strength, also gain 2 Block.

quiet_needle.name: Quiet Needle
quiet_needle.text: Weak applied by cards lasts +1 longer.

blindfold_charm.name: Blindfold Charm
blindfold_charm.text: First enemy attack each combat deals 3 less damage.

still_hand.name: Still Hand
still_hand.text: If you play no attacks on a turn, draw 1 extra card next turn.
